messages:
emily: paging: seeing a spike of 5xx on /v1/generate for EU dedicated pool, PD alert fired.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-2026 created; on-call: sanjay.
sanjay: I’m on it, jumping into logs now. moving conversation to #incidents for statuspage copy.
olivia: can we confirm customer impact magnitude? rough numbers pls.
emily: from metrics ~30% of requests to eu-dedicated returned 5xx over the last 5m; retries succeed ~40% of the time. Affected: generation streaming and sync endpoints.
mike: seeing OOMs on host g-eu-12 during large-batch workloads; kernel OOM kill traces in syslog.
ops-lead: mitigation plan: 1) reduce default batch window on eu pool, 2) route premium traffic to us fallback, 3) drain problematic host and restart. Implementing now.
emily: drafting initial statuspage message — please review:
```
We are investigating increased errors for generation requests in EU regions. Some requests may return 5xx errors or experience higher latency. Our on-call team is working on mitigations.
Impact: ~30% of requests to EU dedicated pool.
Action: routing premium traffic to fallback pools and draining affected hosts.
Next update: in 30 minutes or when we have more info.
```
sanjay: edit suggestion: call out endpoints (/v1/generate, /v1/stream) and add note about retries.
emily: updated draft with endpoints and retry guidance.
legal: quick read — language ok, avoid promising ETA; say "targeting" next update.
support: can we add guidance for customers to reduce batch sizes and enable client-side retries? we'll start proactive outreach to top 12 accounts.
emily: added support note and removed fixed ETA per legal. Draft ready for publish if no objections.
incident-bot: statuspage draft linked: https://status.redwood.ai/draft/PD-2026 (internal preview).
olivia: +1 to publish once on-call confirms routing is active.
sanjay: routing confirmed, drain started on g-eu-12. publishing now.
incident-bot: STATUSPAGE: Published — "Partial degradation: EU generation". Initial update posted.
support: outreach kicked off to top accounts; templated DM posted to #support-sorted.
ops-lead: early mitigation looks effective, error rate dropped from 30% -> ~8% after routing and scale adjustments. continuing to monitor.
emily: scheduling next update in 20m, will include error-rate and ETA for full remediation.
mike: KV caches flushed and rolling restarts on eu fleet in progress.
incident-bot: Reminder: include incident number PD-2026 and channel link in public copy.
emily: next statuspage update drafted with metrics and remediation steps.
sanjay: LGTM.
ops-lead: error rate now 0.6% over the last 15m.
emily: per runbook, we require <1% for 15m before resolved notice. currently meeting threshold. prepping resolved copy.
emily: resolved draft: ```
Incident resolved. Root cause: OOMs on a EU host triggered by oversized batches; mitigations: drained host, reduced batch sizing, routing fallback applied, rolling restarts performed. No further action required; postmortem forthcoming.
```
legal: fine to publish.
support: will send resolve note to customers we contacted.
incident-bot: STATUSPAGE: Published — "Incident resolved". Timeline and next steps attached (internal link).
emily: thanks team — opening postmortem doc and assigning action items. Great coordination. :tada:
